title: Panaxatriol saponins exert anti-renal fibrosis by suppressing TNF-alpha mediated inflammation and TGF-beta1/Smad3 signaling pathway.
authors: Yi, Si; Li, Feiyan; Ma, Xin; Xu, Yao; Lai, Weijing; Chen, Hongxi; Fan, Junming; Mao, Nan; Ren, Sichong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参三醇皂苷通过TNF-α和TGF-β1/Smad3通路抗肾纤维化，属纯湿实验与药理学研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Renal fibrosis is a key pathological process in the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD). Panaxatriol saponins (PTS), the main bioactive compounds extracted from Panax notoginseng (Burk.) F.H. Chen, have demonstrated antioxidative and anti-inflammatory activities. This study aimed to investigate the potential protective effects of PTS against renal fibrosis and explore the underlying pharmacological mechanisms. A unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) model was established in Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats to induce renal fibrosis. Histopathological changes were assessed using hematoxylin and eosin (HE) staining, Masson's trichrome staining, and transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Network pharmacology and molecular docking approaches were employed to identify potential signaling molecules through which PTS may mitigate renal fibrosis. Western blotting, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR), and immunohistochemistry were utilized to validate the involvement of specific signaling pathways in PTS-mediated anti-fibrotic effects. Our data demonstrated that PTS alleviated renal dysfunction and provided protective effects against renal fibrosis, primarily through the TNF-alpha and TGF-beta1 signaling pathways. Moreover, PTS treatment significantly downregulated pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and Smad3 activity. Additionally, PTS inhibited the expression of key fibrosis markers, including alpha-SMA, collagen I, and fibronectin. Our study suggests that PTS exert a prevention effect in renal fibrosis by blocking the TGF-beta1/Smad3 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 肾纤维化是慢性肾脏病（CKD）进展中的一个关键病理过程。三七总皂苷（PTS），从三七（Panax notoginseng (Burk.) F.H. Chen）中提取的主要生物活性化合物，已显示出抗氧化和抗炎活性。本研究旨在探讨PTS对肾纤维化的潜在保护作用，并探索其潜在的药理学机制。在Sprague-Dawley（SD）大鼠中建立单侧输尿管梗阻（UUO）模型以诱导肾纤维化。使用苏木精和伊红（HE）染色、Masson三色染色和透射电子显微镜（TEM）评估组织病理学变化。采用网络药理学和分子对接方法识别PTS可能通过其减轻肾纤维化的潜在信号分子。利用Western blotting、定量实时PCR（qRT-PCR）和免疫组织化学验证PTS介导的抗纤维化效应中特定信号通路的参与。我们的数据表明，PTS缓解了肾功能障碍，并对肾纤维化提供了保护作用，主要通过TNF-alpha和TGF-beta1信号通路实现。此外，PTS处理显著下调了促炎细胞因子，如TNF-alpha、IL-6，以及Smad3活性。另外，PTS抑制了关键纤维化标志物的表达，包括alpha-SMA、胶原蛋白I和纤连蛋白。我们的研究表明，PTS通过阻断TGF-beta1/Smad3信号通路在肾纤维化中发挥预防作用。
